items.exampleEn: A friend tipped me off about the job opening.
items.exampleZh: 一個朋友私下通知我有這個職缺。

items.exampleEn: The new year ushered in big changes.
items.exampleZh: 新的一年開啟了重大的改變。

items.exampleEn: We whiled away long summer days by the lake.
items.exampleZh: 我們在湖邊消磨了漫長的夏日。

items.exampleEn: The company's overseas business was losing money, so the owners slowly wound it down.
items.exampleZh: 這家公司的海外業務一直虧錢，所以老闆們逐步把它結束了。

items.exampleEn: Results must be written up within a week.
items.exampleZh: 結果必須在一週內寫成報告。

items.exampleEn: Universities conduct research in many different fields.
items.exampleZh: 大學在許多不同的領域進行研究。

items.exampleEn: Readers should draw a conclusion only after seeing all the facts.
items.exampleZh: 讀者應該在看完所有事實之後再下結論。

items.sentenceEn: Reading before bed helps me wind down.
items.sentenceZh: 睡前閱讀能幫助我放鬆。

items.audioEn: A neighbor tipped us off that the bakery was giving away free bread, so we went early.
items.audioZh: 一位鄰居私下告訴我們麵包店在送免費麵包，所以我們一早就去了。
items.questionZh: 他們為什麼一早就去麵包店？
options: Someone told them about free bread there
They wanted to buy a cake

items.sentenceEn: Our class will conduct research on local rivers.
items.sentenceZh: 我們班會針對當地的河川進行研究。

items.sentenceEn: Cell phones ushered in a new way of shopping.
items.sentenceZh: 手機開創了一種新的購物方式。

items.stemEn: We need more data before we can ____.
items.stemZh: 我們需要更多資料才能得出結論。

items.stemEn: After the experiment, each student must ____ the results in a short report.
items.stemZh: 實驗結束後，每個學生都必須把結果寫成一份簡短的報告。

items.passageEn: For two years, a team of scientists at our university has been conducting research on how city noise affects birds. They recorded bird songs in quiet parks and next to busy roads all over the city. The data suggest that birds near traffic sing at a higher pitch. However, Professor Kao, the leader of the team, says the results are not yet strong enough to draw a conclusion. The project will wind down next spring, and after that the team plans to collect its findings and write them up for a well-known science journal.
items.passageZh: 兩年來，我們大學的一組科學家一直在研究城市噪音對鳥類的影響。他們在全市安靜的公園和車多的馬路旁錄下鳥叫聲。資料顯示，靠近車流的鳥叫聲音調比較高。不過，團隊的負責人高教授說，目前的結果還不足以下結論。這個計畫會在明年春天逐步結束，之後團隊打算整理研究發現並寫成報告，投稿到一份知名的科學期刊。

options: 公園裡有哪些種類的鳥
鳥在冬天會飛到哪裡去
城市的交通要怎麼改善

questions.questionZh: 研究團隊明年春天之後打算做什麼？
options: 到別的城市錄更多鳥叫聲
在公園旁邊蓋一條新的道路
繼續研究另一個新的主題

items.promptZh: 等火車時，我們靠玩紙牌消磨時間。
referenceEn: While waiting for the train, we whiled away the time playing cards.
We whiled the time away playing cards while we waited for the train.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「消磨時間」（例如 whiled away the time、whiled the time away 等）
不用片語但意思正確也算對（例如 passed the time、killed time playing cards 等）
時態可用過去式或現在式（例如 whiled away、while away 等）
「玩紙牌」可寫，例如 playing cards 等

items.promptZh: 有人事先向記者透露了消息。
referenceEn: Someone tipped off the reporters in advance.
Someone had tipped the reporters off beforehand.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「透露消息」（例如 tipped off the reporters 等）
不用片語但意思正確也算對（例如 told、warned the reporters、leaked the news to the reporters 等）
時態可用過去式、過去完成式或現在完成式（例如 tipped off、had tipped off、has tipped off 等）
「事先」可寫，例如 in advance、beforehand 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 審題員 issue 結案：被動句「Long summer days were whiled away by the lake.」中 by the lake 容易被讀成被動語態的施事者（被湖消磨），有歧義且 while away 很少用被動；建議改主動，如 We whiled away long summer days by the lake.
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 已修正：例句改為主動句 "We whiled away long summer days by the lake."（中譯「我們在湖邊消磨了漫長的夏日。」）
